value.deck: Azure App Service now offers a public preview for Markdown rendering support in agent-based applications, simplifying how AI agents can serve formatted content.
shortVersion: Here is the simple version: Azure App Service now offers a public preview for Markdown rendering support in agent-based applications, simplifying how AI agents can serve formatted content.
Markdown support for agents enables richer structured outputs from AI-powered services hosted on App Service, improving the developer experience for building agent-driven applications.
